supported_languages.label: Banglish (Romanized Bengali)
supported_languages.description: Colloquial Bengali written using the English/Latin alphabet, common in South Asian social commerce messaging.

supported_languages.label: Natural English
supported_languages.description: Standard conversational English used by shoppers.

supported_languages.label: Mixed Bangla-English (Code-switching)
supported_languages.description: Conversations that naturally alternate between Bengali script and English, or Banglish and English vocabulary.

LOW.description: Standard inquiry, catalog lookup, stock check, or basic greeting. AI handles autonomously with zero human intervention required.

MEDIUM.description: Standard customer service question, delivery timing request, exchange procedure, or mild sizing confusion. Resolved with grounded business policies.

HIGH.description: Customer has suffered a verified delivery delay past SLA, damaged goods, repeated failure to resolve in chat, or expressed severe dissatisfaction.

CRITICAL.description: Immediate business risk: allegations of fraud, double payment deduction, legal/consumer rights complaint threats, severe verbal escalation, or safety issues.
